_comment: Sidecar allowlist for update_label_db / lint_pret_labels (fidelity plan Stage 2.1).
relocated_files / relocated_labels are a LEGACY-DEBT inventory, not permission or precedent. NEW RELOCATIONS ARE FORBIDDEN.
Every pret counterpart belongs at dos_port/src/<pret path>; move legacy entries back to their mirrors when touched.
structural_findings records audited legacy violations as OPEN debt, never precedent or authority for new work.
Agents may not add entries or edit either category to make their own lint failure pass; registry edits may only retire/reclassify debt and the exact file hash is approved outside the worktree.
Legacy entries began as a 2026-07-07 full-tree inventory and remain subject to structural audit.

DisplayTwoOptionMenu.problem: the former relocation justification says the pret routine is not standalone and keeps it with port-private state/helpers, which does not establish a pure independently callable relocation
DisplayTwoOptionMenu.retirement: move a complete independently callable DisplayTwoOptionMenu to dos_port/src/engine/menus/text_box.asm and preserve the pret call boundary

IsSpriteOrSignInFrontOfPlayer.problem: the former relocation justification admits only the sign branch is translated while the sprite scan and counter-range behavior are split or absent
IsSpriteOrSignInFrontOfPlayer.retirement: restore the complete pret routine and its entry/call boundaries in dos_port/src/home/overworld.asm

PrintMonType.problem: the former relocation justification admits PrintMonType is fused with the separate missing pret label EraseType2Text
PrintMonType.retirement: separate PrintMonType and EraseType2Text under their exact labels in dos_port/src/engine/battle/print_type.asm

engine/menus/link_menu.asm.why: The 18 labels are the COLOSSEUM cup ELIGIBILITY rules (PokeCup/PikaCup/PetitCup and their 15 verdict routines), reached only as data through PointerTable_f5488. They are a different concern from the two menus with a different dependency set: they scan the party, read the Pokedex entry pointers (link_cups.o depends on assets/dex_entries.inc) and call GetMonName, and they touch no window, tilemap or menu-driver state at all — pret bundles them with the menus only because they share a ROM bank. Reviewed on the merits 2026-07-14 (menu-fidelity row 20 part 2), NOT kept as boilerplate: no pret label is forked, renamed or duplicated across the split (link_cups.asm externs the Colosseum*Text wrappers from link_menu.asm and prints them itself, exactly as pret does), faithdiff/label_status key on labels rather than files, and the discovery trail runs both ways (each file's header names the other and the pret file). Merging back would put ~1500 lines in one file, which is the size at which this very review had to be split across two iterations.

engine/menus/start_sub_menus.asm.why: DrawTrainerInfo + its 5 TrainerInfo_* helpers are one self-contained SCREEN (VRAM tile loads, Red's front pic, box drawing, present/teardown); pret bundles them into start_sub_menus.asm only because they share a ROM bank with the six unrelated StartMenu_* dispatchers, which the flat port has no reason to reproduce. Reviewed on the merits 2026-07-13 (menu-fidelity row 10), NOT kept as boilerplate: no pret label is forked, renamed or duplicated across the split, faithdiff/label_status key on labels rather than files, and the discovery trail runs both ways (start_sub_menus.asm:116-119 externs name trainer_card.asm; trainer_card.asm's header names pret's file). Merging back would push the dispatch file past 1700 lines for zero cross-reference gain.

DiscardButtonPresses.why: pret engine/joypad.asm is the REJECTED faithful-input model and is DEAD (in no Makefile SRCS list, and unlinkable: it ends in `jmp Joypad`, which the port never defines). The port's live input model is the src/input/joypad.asm HAL, which polls from the DelayFrame pipeline - the documented port-input-model DEVIATION (pret's `call Joypad` has no port counterpart). DiscardButtonPresses is model-neutral (it just zeroes hJoyHeld/hJoyPressed/hJoyReleased) and was ALREADY live here, inlined as the local label `.discard`; overworld-events Stage 4 extracted it into a real global because DoBoulderDustAnimation calls it. Permanent while the port-input-model deviation stands.

Retire this entry by deleting engine/joypad.asm, or by dropping its DiscardButtonPresses copy, if that reference is ever cashed in or abandoned (overworld-events Stage 4).
